_note: Sample data for a FICTIONAL brand, Lumina Home. People, figures and reports are invented for the demo.

guidelines.title: Tone of voice
guidelines.body: Warm, clear and confident. Write like a helpful neighbour who knows lighting. No slang or text-speak, no hype words, no more than one exclamation mark per piece.

guidelines.title: Messaging pillars
guidelines.body: Every piece supports at least one pillar: 1) Real energy savings, 2) Simple set-up, 3) Trust and honesty. Describe the product as smart lighting. Lead with the customer benefit, not the technology.

guidelines.title: Claims policy
guidelines.body: Every number, comparison and guarantee must match an approved fact. Superlatives such as best, number one or most are not allowed without approved evidence. The only guarantee we offer is the 30-day money-back guarantee. Facts past their review date must be re-approved before use.

terms.reason: Hype word. Describe the benefit instead.
Text-speak does not fit our tone.
The product name is singular, even for several bulbs.

facts.statement: LuminaBulb uses up to 75% less energy than incandescent bulbs.
LuminaBulb is rated for up to 25,000 hours of use.
Every LuminaBulb comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee.
